Subject: Adoption runway & canary migration checklist — Pathfinder Health

Hi Alejandro —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get Pathfinder live. I attached a working MAP and a proposed canary schedule to embed inside the plan. High-level asks from our side so we can finalize timelines: 

- Confirm staging cluster access (SSH keys or IAM role) by 2027-05-10.
- Approve a 2–3 week canary window (we recommended 3 weeks but will compress if you prefer).
- Identify ops and security leads who will join the pre-cutover checklist review on 2027-05-12.

Key milestones in the attached MAP_Pathfinder_v1.xlsx:
- Week 0: Staging access & smoke tests
- Week 1–3: Canary (10% then 50% traffic ramps)
- Week 4: Migration cutover & monitoring ramp
- Week 5: Knowledge transfer + ops runbook handoff

I've also attached Canary_Schedule.pdf with the rollback decision points and success criteria (latency, error rate, token-quality regression thresholds).

Can you confirm the procurement contact who will issue the PO and whether a signed acceptance of the MAP is required?

Thanks — I can hop on a 30-minute call this afternoon if you'd like to walk through the MAP.

Kimberly — thanks and congrats to the folks at Redwood. Quick answers and requests: 

- Procurement: procurement@pathfinderhealth.com will issue a purchase order; they prefer the MAP as an attachment to the SOW. I've looped them in separately.
- Canary window: we prefer a 2-week canary if we can keep the first week as a low-traffic validation (10–20%) and the second week at 50–75%. Can you confirm rollback thresholds and alerting hooks?
- Security evidence: our security team will need SOC 2 summary and data retention details before staging access. Can Marcus share the short evidence pack?
- Training: Ops wants two 90-minute live sessions (one for SREs, one for app owners) scheduled in the week after cutover.

We have a tentative PO intent attached (PO_Intent.pdf). Happy to do a call today at 3pm PT; otherwise tomorrow morning works.

Alejandro —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Short technical notes to align with the MAP and Canary_Schedule: 

Pre-canary checklist (we'll run these with your SREs):
- Provide staging IAM role + VPC peering details.
- Shared test workload: provide 3 representative prompt patterns and dataset for quality checks.
- Baseline telemetry: capture 48h of request/latency percentiles before canary.

Canary plan (2-week variant):
- Day 1–3: 10% traffic, validate P95 latency and end-to-end success.
- Day 4–7: 30% traffic, run regression evals on sampled prompts.
- Day 8–14: 50–75% traffic, monitor error budget and model-output drift.

Rollback criteria (automated + manual):
- Automatic rollback if 3 consecutive hours where error-rate > 2x baseline OR P95 latency > 2x SLA.
- Manual rollback option if quality regressions on key prompt set exceed 5% (per agreed eval).

I've attached a short canary_playbook.md with the exact CLI commands, expected CloudWatch alerts, and warm-up hooks for the KV cache.

For SOC 2 and retention notes: I'll pull the redacted evidence pack and send to procurement + security tonight.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
